title: Trilegal acts on Kimbal $22 million Series B fundraise
description: Kimbal Private Limited has raised $22 million from a Series B fundraise led by GEF Capital Partners, with participation from Niveshaay Sambhav Fund.Trilegal advised Kimbal on this fundraise.The Corporate Practice team was led by Sanjam Arora (Partner), and comprised Anamika Ray (Counsel), Jagrati Gupta (Counsel) and Vagmita Tiwari (Associate).The Capital Markets team consisted of Vijay Parthasarathi (Partner) and Saurav Das (Senior Associate).Sanjam Arora, Vijay ParthasarathiFounded in 2011 by A
